Stephi's father has the manure business waiting for him and will not take no, and the coworkers spend the run-up telling him what marriage will be.

Trois places pour le 26.basis: Mylene had the child after they parted and never told him, and never told Marion whose daughter she is, so the two of them meet as a star and a fan and spend a night together before the breakfast conversation gives it away.

Montand comes back to Marseille to stage his own life and spends his free hours looking for the girl he loved when he was nobody, and finds her behind the Baroness de Lambert's card, in the bar they first met in, about to lose her home while her husband serves five years.
Marion is selling scent and asking for three seats for the 26th, and when the leading lady has to go because she is pregnant she puts herself forward and gets the part.

The musical being rehearsed is Montand's own life as he tells it - the unknown years, the first love he lost, then Piaf and Monroe - and he is on stage performing it while the woman it is about is in the audience.

A City of Sadness.role: the one who cannot contest it
A City of Sadness.basis: Wen-ching, who has been deaf since he was a boy, is taken from the miners' hospital into a system running summary trials; he comes out once, delivers an executed cellmate's things to the widow, is taken again, and Hinomi can find no record of him anywhere in Taipei.

The Shanghai gang settle the quarrel over Red Monkey's money by using their mainland connections to have the Lin brothers denounced as Japanese collaborators; Wen-liang comes out of the cells with his brain damaged.
Wen-hsiung finds out only by accident that his own brother, his concubine's brother and the Shanghai men have been running contraband through his ships and his storehouse.
Wen-ching finds Hinoe in the mountains with the guerillas and asks to join them; Hinoe sends him back down and tells him Hinomi loves him.
After the arrest Hinomi keeps the household going with the baby and writes to Ah-shue that she has been round Taipei asking for word of him and there is none.

Black Rain.basis: Every family that comes to look at Yasuko withdraws the moment they hear she was in Hiroshima that morning, on the grounds that she may sicken or bear sick children, and no certificate of her health makes any difference.
Shigematsu buries one hibakusha friend after another while watching his own wife and niece begin to go the same way, and stands in the road at the end waiting for a rainbow over the ambulance.
Yasuko was taken in by her uncle and aunt as a half-orphan, and when her remarried father offers her a place in his house she stays with them.

When Yuichi's mother asks his consent to the marriage, Shigematsu - whose own niece has been refused all round for what happened to her - is indignant at the young man's war trauma before he will consider it.

Crimes and Misdemeanors.basis: Dolores threatens to take the affair to Miriam and can also describe the financial dealings that built the practice, so Judah has her shot and goes to the flat himself for the letters.

The killing is written off to a drifter with a record, the guilt lifts after a few months, and Judah tells the story to Cliff at the wedding as a hypothetical and then goes home cheerfully with his wife.
Judah takes it to his brother Jack, who finds the man and arranges it, so that Judah is only ever the one who made the phone call.
Halley turns Cliff down gently and goes to London, and comes back engaged to Lester, who had sent her white roses round the clock for days.
Paid to make a life of Lester, Cliff cuts him against Mussolini on the balcony, against himself shouting at his staff and making a pass at a young actress, and screens it to the man's face.

Decalogue V.basis: Jacek carries a rope round the city, plays pointless cruelties on strangers, and strangles and then stones a taxi driver he has no quarrel with; five years earlier his twelve-year-old sister was run down by a driver who had been drinking with Jacek that afternoon.
The state does its killing with the same deliberateness the film gave the first one: the room, the straps, several men holding him down, and the drop.

Decalogue V.role: the one who cannot contest it
Decalogue V.basis: Piotr goes into the judge's chambers to ask whether a better lawyer could have saved his client, and is told his was the finest argument against the death penalty the judge had heard and that it could never have made any difference.

In the last hour Jacek asks to be put in beside his sister and father although there is one place left and his mother would have to give it up, and hands Piotr the enlarged photograph of the girl to take to her.

Sweetie.basis: Sweetie arrives back with Bob and takes the house over - Kay's clothes ruined, the furniture broken, everyone managed round her rages and then forgiven the next morning.

The flashbacks are Gordon holding his daughter up through her tricks and songs, and he goes on treating a grown woman as that child rather than as ill; Flo says plainly that he indulges her, and the family keep the little girl at the end.
Stripped and painted black in the childhood tree house, Sweetie will not come down for any of them and keeps rocking the fort until it comes out of the tree, killing her and injuring Flo underneath.
Kay digs up the sapling Louis plants in the yard and hides it because of what the fortune teller's words have made her fear, and says nothing to him about having done it.

Close-Up.basis: Sabzian tells the woman beside him on the bus, who is reading about The Cyclist, that he is Makhmalbaf, and spends a fortnight in the Ahankhah house promising to shoot his next film there with the sons in it, and borrowing 1,900 tomans for cab fare.

Mr Ahankhah, having seen a magazine photograph of a younger, darker Makhmalbaf, brings the journalist Farazmand into the house to identify him, and Farazmand photographs the arrest for a piece called Bogus Makhmalbaf Arrested.
In court Sabzian says he did it because the films let him feel seen in his own suffering, and the judge puts it to the Ahankhahs, who pardon him on condition that he makes something of himself.
The real Makhmalbaf meets him at the prison gate and gives him a lift to the Ahankhahs' door, where the father says he hopes the man will be good now and make them proud of him.

Days of Thunder.basis: Daland puts Russ Wheeler in the seat while Cole is mending from Daytona and then runs both cars, and takes his new driver's side over Harry's and Cole's every time.

Harry left the sport a year after Buddy Bretherton was killed in one of his cars and comes out of retirement to build Cole a chassis and drill the terms of the trade into a driver who does not know what loose or tight means.

His own team-mate blocks his pit stall at North Wilkesboro and puts him in the outside wall on the last lap, Cole drives into him on the cool-down, and the whole shop ends in a fight that gets Cole and Harry fired.

Cole and Rowdy Burns run each other harder every week for no reason either can name until they take each other out at the Firecracker 400, and Big John sits them down and sends them off to wreck rental cars on the beach instead.
Rowdy, going in for surgery on a burst vessel in his brain, asks Cole to drive his car at Daytona so that his sponsor will pay out his year.

Tasmania Story.basis: Shoichi has not seen his father since the divorce and his mother is dead, so he spends his last spring break as a sixth-grader flying to Sydney on an old address and then following him to Tasmania.
Kawano has the boy on his hands at the same time as the conservation fight against his old trading company and his own hunt for a thylacine that has been extinct for fifty years.
Kawano has broken with the leading Japanese trading house he was an executive of because he cannot square its logging and land practices in Tasmania with himself, and now campaigns against them.
Shoichi crosses to Tasmania with Minoru, a runaway he picks up in Sydney, each of them travelling because of a father.

Total Recall.basis: Cohaagen has had Hauser's memory wiped and replaced with the Quaid identity, a wife and a construction job, so that Quaid lives a life whose facts about himself are administered by Cohaagen until the Rekall visit and the recorded message begin to surface them.

Cohaagen explains that Quaid was manufactured out of Hauser purely as a ruse to slip past Kuato's psychic reading and destroy the mutant rebellion — a purpose Quaid himself is never made party to until the base is already massacred.
Cohaagen orders Hauser's memories restored in the man he built, and instead Quaid refuses the role, throws the explosive into the tunnel and blows Cohaagen out onto the Martian surface to suffocate.

Quaid's wife Lori attacks him at home and tells him she was assigned by the Agency to monitor him, that their marriage is an implanted memory, and that Richter is her real husband; Quaid later kills her.

Cohaagen rules the Mars colony through his turbinium monopoly and the cheap domes that mutated Venusville's people, and shuts off Venusville's air to suffocate its inhabitants until Quaid starts the alien reactor.

Benny drives Quaid and Melina to safety and into the hidden rebel base, then shoots George to reveal he has been in Cohaagen's employ throughout, opening the way for the attack that kills Kuato and the rebels.

Doc Hollywood.basis: Lou hides her feelings for Ben and tells him she is marrying Hank because she does not want him to waste his talents in Grady; only when Hank reports the engagement is off does Ben return to her.
Ben and the insurance agent Hank both court Lou, and Ben leaves town at night partly so as not to incite Hank's jealousy over her.
After Ben saves Dr. Hogue's life during his heart attack, the grateful Hogue privately telephones Dr. Halberstrom to excuse Ben's delay, and Halberstrom hires Ben on Hogue's recommendation.
After the intimate evening with Lou, Ben slips out of Grady at night without telling her he is going.
Mayor Nicholson's committee courts Ben to replace the retiring Dr. Hogue at Grady Memorial, and Hogue, who had dismissed Ben as too young and inexperienced, ends up recommending him.

1492 – Conquest of Paradise.basis: Four years into the colony the natives are forced to mine gold for the Spaniards, and Moxica cuts off the hand of one who fails to produce any, after which the tribes vanish into the forest and the island turns to war.
Columbus's aristocratic subordinate Moxica burns down his house and leads a faction of settlers against him; Columbus's side prevails and Moxica kills himself rather than be captured.

1492 – Conquest of Paradise.role: the one who cannot contest it
1492 – Conquest of Paradise.basis: Columbus ends as an old man forgotten in Spain with the discovery of the New World credited to Amerigo Vespucci, able only to dictate his own version to his son Ferdinand.

Queen Isabella alone can grant the ships, and gives them on the promise of gold; when the gold is scant and the colony fails she reassigns his governorship, has him recalled, and permits a last voyage only on condition he take neither his brothers nor return to the colonies.

Columbus signs his crew on by telling them the crossing will take seven weeks; at nine weeks with no land the men grow restless and edge toward mutiny until his speech and a rising wind put them back to their duties.
The Catholic theologians at Salamanca reject Columbus's westward plan because it contradicts the writings of Ptolemaeus, and he presses on to Pinzón, Santángel and the Queen regardless.

Goopy Bagha Phire Elo.basis: Brahmananda Acharya invites Goopy and Bagha to Anandagarh fort and sets them to steal three valuable stones with their ghost-given powers while he stays clear of the theft, paying them with a promise of twenty years' youth he knows he cannot deliver.
Bhuter Raja appears to Goopy and Bagha in a dream and tells them to keep off injustice, after which they apologize and return the two stolen stones to their owners.

To forestall the prophecy that a twelve-year-old named Bikram will destroy him, Acharya has his soldiers kidnap every twelve-year-old boy in Anandapur named Bikram and hypnotizes them into his servants.

The Best Intentions.basis: Anna's letter from Switzerland asking Henrik to resume the relationship is intercepted by her parents — Johan opens it and Karin reads and burns it — and only after Johan's death does Karin confess, whereupon Anna goes to Henrik and marries him.
Henrik goes on secretly living with Frida the waitress while courting and becoming engaged to Anna, until Karin tells Anna and the family verifies it.

Pregnant and upset, Anna insists the orphan Petrus the Bergmans took in be sent away, saying she never agreed to a permanent adoption and dislikes him; Petrus overhears, carries baby Dag to an icy river, and leaves after Henrik slaps him down.

Asked by Queen Victoria at Sophiahemmet whether suffering is sent by God, Henrik answers that suffering is useless and that God views the world with horror, then leaves the palace fuming at having had to flatter her.
Henrik publicly humiliates the mill owner Nordenson in church after Nordenson refuses to kneel with his wife and daughters, which disturbs the Forsboda villagers.

Thunderheart.basis: A government-sponsored uranium strip mine at Red Deer Table poisons the reservation's water while Frank's informant Richard stirs up the ARM against Jack Milton's tribal council, and Milton takes kickbacks from the leases the quarrel keeps covered.

The FBI under Coutelle fixes Leo Fast Elk's murder on ARM leader Jimmy Looks Twice, until Walter Crow Horse's evidence that the killer was heavier and drove Leo's car leads Ray to the real killer, Richard Yellow Hawk.

Frank Coutelle visits Richard Yellow Hawk in prison, offers a reduced sentence for favors and then blackmails him with the threat of return, using him to kill Leo Fast Elk and inflame the reservation while Frank runs the official investigation.
Once Richard Yellow Hawk confesses to Ray that Frank put him up to Leo's murder, Richard is found dead with his wrists slit to pass as suicide.
Maggie Eagle Bear, who identifies the raffle stub and is pressing the question of the reservation's contaminated water, turns up dead at the Red Deer Table mining site.

Ray Levoi is put on the case by the Bureau for his mixed Sioux blood, and Walter Crow Horse reads his Wounded Knee dream as proof he is Thunderheart returned — a name he ends up living up to by quitting the FBI.

Waterland.basis: The gypsy woman's botched abortion of teenage Mary's pregnancy leaves her infertile, and in 1974 Tom lives inside her longing for the son they never had, which ends with her taking a stranger's baby from a supermarket as 'a gift from God'.

Tom Crick abandons the history syllabus to narrate the abortion, his jealousy of Dick and Freddie Parr's drowning to his Pittsburgh schoolchildren, and to Matthew Price in particular, none of whom can punish or absolve him; the complaints get him dismissed.

In the attic Dick makes Tom read out their grandfather's letter and tell him what it says — that Dick was fathered on his mother by that grandfather — after which Dick breaks down, runs to the river and drowns himself.
After Tom asks Mary to 'teach' his brother Dick about sex, she denies to Tom that anything took place and insists the baby is his; the question of whose child it was is never cleared between them.
Believing wealthy Freddie Parr fathered Mary's baby, Dick gets him drunk on the grandfather's special brew, hits him with the bottle and throws him in the river to pass as a drowning.
Mary abducts an infant from a woman in a supermarket and Tom has to help her hand the baby back before urging her to see a counsellor.

Farewell My Concubine.basis: Dieyi loves Xiaolou across fifty years — painting his stage face before every performance, even wiping and finishing it during the Red Guards' struggle session — while Xiaolou marries Juxian, denounces him, and can only call him 'Douzi' after Dieyi cuts his own throat with the sword.

Master Guan's troupe beats Douzi each time he says 'I am by nature a boy, not a girl' until he delivers the dan monologue correctly, and Dieyi lives the rest of his life inside Consort Yu, dying by her sword when the old slip returns in 1977.

Dieyi and the ex-prostitute Juxian each hold a whole claim on Xiaolou — she buys her freedom to have an ordinary life with him, Dieyi feels betrayed by the marriage — and the three-way conflict runs from the wedding to Juxian returning the sword and hanging herself.

At the struggle session Xiaolou tells the Red Guards Dieyi is homosexual, and Dieyi answers by naming Juxian a former prostitute before the crowd — after which Xiaolou disowns her and she kills herself.

Douzi takes the troupe's beating in Shitou's place as a boy, and as Dieyi sings for the Japanese to get Xiaolou released from arrest, which afterwards leaves him charged with treason by the Kuomintang.
Douzi's prostitute mother leaves him at Master Guan's Peking opera troupe in 1924, and the other apprentices mock him for where he came from.
Invited to perform at eunuch Zhang's house, Douzi is called to Zhang's room and sexually assaulted; Shitou understands what happened and Douzi never speaks of it.

Guilty as Sin.basis: Greenhill reveals in the empty courtroom that he had been scouting Jennifer Haines long before he killed his wife Rita, selecting her as his defence attorney for a plan she was never made party to.
After the mistrial Greenhill privately gives Haines vivid details of how he murdered Rita, knowing attorney-client privilege leaves her unable to use it against him.
Haines takes Greenhill on as a client and he then appears uninvited in her social life, stalks her, beats Phil into hospital and tries to stage her suicide at her apartment building.
Greenhill knocks out the investigator Moe and burns his office once Moe has dug up his history of dating older women who end up dead, then comes for Haines as she prepares to disclose everything.
When Haines asks to drop the unpaid client she now believes is a serial killer, the judge tells her it is her own fault and refuses to let her abandon Greenhill's defence.

Schindler's List.basis: Schindler, a German Nazi Party member trading on his friendship with Göth and the SS, builds a sub-camp at his factory and a Brünnlitz munitions plant that produces no usable armaments, in order to keep 1,100 Jews out of Auschwitz.
Schindler pays Göth a huge bribe for the workers named on the list Stern types, and bribes Auschwitz commandant Höss again when the women and girls are misrouted to Birkenau.
Göth runs Płaszów by brutalising his maid Helen Hirsch and shooting prisoners at random from his villa balcony, with the inmates in constant fear and no way out from under him until he is hanged.
Schindler spends his entire fortune over seven months on bribes and on shell casings bought from other companies, and is broke by the German surrender in 1945, so that his workers survive.

The Piano.basis: Baines buys Ada's piano from Stewart with the land Stewart covets and then sets terms — one black key returned per lesson, against escalating sexual demands — before finally giving the instrument back and confessing he wants her to care for him genuinely.

The Piano.role: the one held by the earlier tie
The Piano.basis: Ada, married off to Stewart, cannot have Baines without breaking that marriage; Stewart watches them through a crack in the wall and she is finally released to leave with Baines for Nelson.

Ada is shipped from Scotland to colonial New Zealand with Flora for a marriage to the settler Stewart that was arranged for her, and meets her husband for the first time on the beach where her piano is abandoned.
Stewart tries to force himself on Ada, coerces a promise that she will not see Baines again, and when she breaks it chops off her index finger and sends it to Baines with a threat to take more.
Ada, mute since the age of six, can only be understood through Flora, who signs and speaks for her — until Flora carries her words where she chooses and Ada ends the film taking speech lessons.
Ada sends Flora to Baines with a piano key engraved with a love declaration, and Flora, now bonded to Stewart as a father, hands the package to him instead.

A Confucian Confusion.role: the ones acting in the dark
A Confucian Confusion.basis: Larry pushes Akeem to hand Molly the entertainment company precisely so that its failure will let Akeem reclaim it and her, then audits it, feeds Akeem's jealousy and offers to identify her lover, while Molly runs the company never knowing her situation is being arranged.

Ming presses Qiqi to take the PR job his aunt arranged and leave Molly, then outside his office demands she choose between him and Molly, while Qiqi is unwilling to give up the friendship — she ends by returning to Molly at the empty company and reconciling.

Larry acts as Akeem's friend and auditor and promises to unmask Molly's lover while having designs on Molly himself and denying to Feng that he is pursuing her; when he is caught chasing Birdy with a sword prop, Akeem shoves him into an elevator as Larry complains his friendship went unreciprocated.

Molly tells Ming over lunch that her sister was the one betrothed to Akeem but fell in love with the author, so Akeem's father picked Molly as the replacement bride, and she is still living inside that engagement while Akeem keeps funding her company hoping love will follow.

A Confucian Confusion.role: the one who holds the place
A Confucian Confusion.basis: The author has moved out to a separate apartment to write his pessimistic work while Molly's sister goes on hosting her happiness talk show, and after they trade blows over optimism and pessimism she tells him she will always wait for him.
Ming talks Liren into forging the contractor's weather-delay documents at the bar, and it is Liren who is fired for forgery while Ming returns to his office untouched.

Hoop Dreams.basis: St. Joseph's scout recruits Arthur Agee out of West Garfield Park, then at the end of freshman year he is put out of the school because his family cannot pay tuition, while Gates's fees are covered by his Encyclopedia Britannica sponsor; Agee's confidence collapses and he finishes at John Marshall.
William's older brother Curtis, a talented player who never reached the pros, transfers his unfulfilled aspirations onto William, who plays his sophomore and junior seasons under that weight.
Arthur's father Bo walks out during Arthur's junior year and becomes addicted to drugs while Sheila loses her job and the family goes on welfare; Bo later gives up drugs and returns to the household.

A Last Note.basis: After the Ushigunis leave, Toyoko tells Yoko that she slept with Yoko's husband Saburo 22 years ago while Yoko was on tour and that Saburo fathered her daughter Akemi; Yoko is indignant and Toyoko walks out, but the two settle it and later attend Akemi's tentative-marriage ceremony together.

Yoko packs for Tokyo instructing Toyoko to keep the gardener's riverbed stone — the one he left on his self-made coffin — for nailing down Yoko's own coffin, and once Yoko has gone Toyoko carries the stone to the river and throws it in.

Bad Company.basis: Crowe is hired into Grimes' Toolshed and worked alongside by Wells while secretly reporting to CIA handler Smitty, whose agency intends to seize the firm; Smitty finally tells Wells about the infiltration and she comes to kill Crowe.
Wells, Grimes' second in command, recruits Crowe with a plot to kill her boss and take over the firm; Crowe shoots Grimes at his fishing cabin and beats Wells to stage it as a robbery.
Wells seduces Crowe to get him to murder Grimes, then rebuffs his affections once she controls the Toolshed, having used him for what she wanted.

Grimes gives Crowe $1 million to bribe Washington Supreme Court Justice Beach into swinging the appeal for Curl Industries, sued for poisoning a town's water and causing disabled births; Beach takes the money but votes against Curl.
Smitty holds the disappearance of a $50,000 Iraqi bribe over Crowe and threatens prison time to force him to infiltrate the Toolshed as a mole against his will.
Julie buys a gun from Goodwin and goes to Crowe's apartment to kill him for Beach's death, firing blindly into the shootout in which Crowe and Wells kill each other.

Farewell to Nostradamus.basis: Chris and his henchmen snatch Julia by helicopter from the hijacked plane and later retake her from Lupin's group, holding her at the sect's cathedral until Lupin gets her out and she is reunited with her family.
Chris demands on TV that Douglas quit the presidential race to get his daughter back, and Douglas refuses, saying the kidnapping will win his campaign sympathy.
Fujiko took the job of chaperoning Julia only so she could get inside the Earth Building and steal the lost prophecies from Douglas's top-floor safe.

Rhisley preaches from a fake book of Nostradamus's prophecies, reciting a verse that 'predicted' the hijacking Chris arranged, and later announces the Earth Building will explode while Chris's hypnotised bombers make it happen.
Chris triggers the wrist bands worn by the Brazilian national football team staying in the Earth Building, hypnotising them into planting bombs throughout it while he stays clear.
The Nostradamus Sect seizes Lupin's Uncle Philip, the only man ever to open Douglas's vault, and uses a machine to extract how he did it, killing him in the process.

Memories.basis: In Magnetic Rose, the diva Eva Friedel murdered her fiancé and fellow singer Carlo Rambaldi for refusing to marry her, and has since forced trapped salvagers to relive his likeness inside her station.

Seduced by Eva's holograms deep in the station's cavern, the engineer Miguel is made to believe he is Carlo Rambaldi and is last seen talking romantically with her, fully embracing the dead singer's identity.

The Corona answers a distress signal that turns out to be emitted by a broken piano in Eva's station — the emergency was the lure of the woman the wreck belongs to, and the ship is torn apart by her magnetic field.
The head of the research company, having ordered Nobuo to deliver the experimental pills to Tokyo, joins the military in ordering him killed once they work out he is the source of the gas.
In Cannon Fodder, the schoolboy asks his father why they are firing on the enemy at all, and his father answers only that he will understand when he is older.
The boy's father, a cannon-loader, is blamed for a safety mishap on the giant red railway gun and made to stand beside it without safety gear while the lavishly dressed officer fires it again.

One Hundred and One Nights.basis: Camille recruits her boyfriend's friend's brother, also named Vincent, to arrive at the château posing as Simon Cinéma's missing great-grandson, coaching him with childhood details so he can fool the groundskeeper and the delusional old man into signing over the inheritance.

Camille is hired to sit with Simon Cinéma nightly to talk about cinema, and uses that nightly access — steering him toward thoughts of Vincent's return, feigning ignorance when 'Vincent' is introduced — to work the inheritance scheme that would fund Mica's short film.

The century-old Cinéma sits isolated in his château while Camille, Mica, the fake Vincent and finally Marina all approach him for his fortune, and Marina, whom he takes for Elizabeth Taylor, gets him to sign the whole of it over to her at the garden party.

Something to Talk About.basis: Grace sees Eddie kissing a blonde woman outside the bank, then follows his lie about a client dinner to the restaurant and catches him with her, and he denies the kiss to her face.
Grace researches her father Wyly's past and brings out that he cheated on her mother Georgia with multiple women, after which Georgia throws him out of the house.
Grace goes to her father Wyly for support after leaving Eddie, and he gives her none, his attention fixed entirely on the upcoming show jumping competition.
Grace lightly poisons Eddie using her grandmother's recipe after catching him with the other woman, and he responds by secretly consulting a divorce attorney.

City Hall.basis: Calhoun, Pappas's loyal deputy mayor, discovers that his mentor personally facilitated Anselmo's bribe on the Zapattis' behalf to buy Judge Stern his judgeship and keep Tino out of jail, and confronts Pappas, who acquiesces to resigning.

The probation report that would have sent Tino Zapatti to prison on his drug conviction was suppressed and Judge Stern, installed by an Anselmo bribe, left him free on probation — until the report is recovered from Anselmo's car.

Tino's cousin Vinnie is found dead after telling Calhoun why Santos approached Tino, Schwartz is murdered mid-phone-call with Calhoun while holding the incriminating probation report, and Zapatti orders Anselmo to shoot himself so he cannot become an informant.

Anselmo, at Paul Zapatti's behest, plants money to incriminate the dead Detective Eddie Santos and pressures Internal Affairs to portray the decorated cop as dirty, while Cogan and Calhoun work to clear him.

Hard Eight.basis: Sydney picks the homeless John up outside a Sparks diner, stakes him the $6,000 for his mother's funeral, makes him a protégé and tells him on the phone that he loves him like a son — while never telling him that he killed John's father in Atlantic City.

Jimmy pulls a gun on Sydney and demands $10,000 to keep quiet about the Atlantic City killing, settles for $6,000 from the casino cashier, and Sydney later waits in Jimmy's house and shoots him, taking the cash back.

Sydney arrives at the motel where John and Clementine are holding a beaten tourist hostage over an unpaid trick, talks them into fleeing on a honeymoon, and stays behind to clear the evidence from the room.
John, broke outside a diner, tells a stranger he needs $6,000 for his mother's funeral, and Sydney — owing him nothing — buys him coffee and takes him to Vegas to win it.

Lupin III: Dead or Alive.basis: Lupin arrives at the floating island disguised as Prince Panish and asks Olèander for the pendant key, which she hands over believing him to be the prince she loves; the nanomachines turn hostile once the disguise breaks.
Olèander, the Zufu police agent posing as Headhunter's daughter Emerah, learns during the escape from Zenigata that Headhunter has been using her to get at the key, and is then captured by Crisis.
Headhunter holds Dr. Voltsky prisoner while telling his daughter Emerah that her father is dead, until Fujiko, planted as her secretary, helps her escape.
General Headhunter seized Zufu by coup and killed its king, leaving Prince Panish the only surviving royal and forcing him into hiding.

Sleepers.basis: The guards charged with the boys' custody at Wilkinson Home for Boys — Nokes, Addison, Ferguson and Styler — repeatedly rape and torture Shakes, Tommy, Michael and John, culminating in a 'farewell party' gang rape the night before Shakes' release.

John and Tommy shoot Nokes dead in a Hell's Kitchen pub after he dismisses what he did to them, and Michael builds the whole trial as an instrument of revenge on the remaining Wilkinson guards, with Addison abducted and killed by Rizzo's brother Eddie.

Michael, now an assistant district attorney, gets himself assigned to the Nokes murder case in order to botch his own prosecution, secretly drafting Snyder's cross-examination questions so that John and Tommy walk free for a killing they committed in front of witnesses.

Shakes proposes reporting the abuse before release, but Michael argues nobody would believe or care, and the four boys vow never to speak of it again — a silence held for thirteen years until Ferguson admits the abuse on the witness stand.

Shakes asks Father Bobby, the priest who once persuaded him to confess the hot-dog cart accident, to commit perjury; he reluctantly swears John and Tommy were with him at a Knicks game and produces three ticket stubs.

Little Dieter Needs to Fly.basis: After crash-landing his Skyraider in Laos, Dengler is taken by the Pathet Lao and handed to North Vietnamese soldiers, held handcuffed to six other prisoners in a bamboo camp under torture and starvation until he escapes.

Princess Mononoke.basis: Eboshi's iron ball, fired into the boar god Nago, turns him into the demon whose curse lands on Ashitaka's arm and condemns him to death and exile, while Eboshi carries on prospering in Irontown until the curse is lifted at the film's end.

Eboshi beheads the Forest Spirit to secure Irontown's future, and its headless body floods and destroys the town while Moro's severed head bites off Eboshi's arm; she survives repentant and resolves to rebuild.

San, raised by Moro among the wolves and unable to forgive humanity, admits she loves Ashitaka but stays in the forest while he remains to rebuild Irontown, the two promising to meet as often as they can.
Ashitaka forces apart San and Eboshi in the middle of their duel inside Irontown and is shot by one of the townspeople for it, collapsing after carrying San out.

Eboshi and Jigo smear themselves with the blood of the slain boars so that the blind, mortally wounded Okkoto will unknowingly lead them to the Forest Spirit; his pain turns him into a demon and the Forest Spirit grants him death.

Flowers of Shanghai.basis: Crimson, Jasmin, Jade and Emerald keep long semi-monogamous arrangements with wealthy patrons — Master Wang, Master Zhu, Luo — who maintain them inside the flower houses in exchange for their company.

After four or five years with Crimson, Master Wang is refused her hand in marriage, takes up with the younger Jasmin instead, agrees to marry Jasmin and departs for Guangdong, leaving Crimson angered.
Emerald, bought as a child for $100, haggles across the whole film with the auntie who insists her freedom is worth $3,000, and with Master Hong and Luo's help settles a price and leaves the brothel.
Master Zhu promised Jade that if they could not marry they would die together; when the marriage plainly will not happen she feeds him opium and tries to drink it herself.
Master Wang discovers Crimson has been having an affair with an actor and goes into a drunken rage in her rooms.

My Best Fiend.basis: Herzog revisits the apartment, locations and set footage of five films made with Kinski, recounting heated and sometimes violent altercations that kept recurring between them from Aguirre through Cobra Verde without ever being settled.
Herzog retells the story of threatening to shoot Kinski if he walked off the production of Aguirre, the Wrath of God, and Kinski stayed.

Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menac.role: the ones acting in the dark
Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menac.basis: Darth Sidious, the Trade Federation's secret benefactor, orders the blockade and invasion of Naboo and ends the crisis with his public self, Senator Palpatine, elected Supreme Chancellor, while the Jedi only suspect at Qui-Gon's funeral that a second Sith exists.
Watto refuses Republic currency for the hyperdrive part, so Qui-Gon stakes both the part and the nine-year-old slave Anakin's freedom on a podrace, which Anakin wins.
Mortally wounded by Darth Maul in the Theed palace, Qui-Gon's last request is that Obi-Wan train Anakin, and Obi-Wan takes the boy as his apprentice with Yoda's reluctant consent.
Anakin joins Qui-Gon's party to be trained as a Jedi and leaves his mother Shmi behind on Tatooine, 'as is the Jedi way'.
Qui-Gon asks the Jedi Council on Coruscant for permission to train Anakin and is refused on the grounds that the boy's age leaves him open to the dark side; he vows to train him anyway.

The Iron Giant.basis: The Giant bids Hogarth farewell and flies up to collide with the nuclear missile Mansley launched at Rockwell, detonating it in the exosphere so the town's people are not destroyed, at apparent cost of himself.

Hogarth hides the Giant at his home and then in Dean's wrecking yard, where Dean disguises him as a sculpture to get Mansley's soldiers to leave, both of them concealing him from their own government's agent and army.

Mansley and General Rogard treat the Giant as a national threat and attack him, when he only fires defensively — Dean gets Rogard to stand down only after Mansley has already ordered the missile that will hit Rockwell.
Suspecting Hogarth is hiding something, Mansley rents a room in Annie's house specifically to keep the boy under observation, until he finds the photograph linking Hogarth to the Giant.

Eureka.basis: Bus driver Makoto and the orphaned siblings Naoki and Kozue, the three sole survivors of the hijacking, end up living together in the Tamura house and then touring Kyushu in a converted bus as the only people who can reach each other.

The detective who handled the hijacking harasses Makoto over a neighbourhood woman's murder without evidence and later arrests and questions him over a second killing, while the murderer is in fact Naoki.
Makoto feeds and houses Naoki, who stays mute and grows more disturbed as the bus journey goes on, until it emerges he is the murderer and Makoto confronts him and persuades him to turn himself in.
Some time after the hijacking the Tamura children's mother abandons the family, and after their father dies in a car crash Naoki and Kozue go on living alone in the house.
Makoto takes to the road after the hijacking and returns home to find his estranged wife has gone from the family house.

Faithless.role: the one held by the earlier tie
Faithless.basis: Marianne, married to the conductor Markus and mother to Isabelle, begins an affair with her friend David in Paris, moves in with him and becomes pregnant, and cannot keep both men — the marriage ends in divorce proceedings and Markus's suicide.
Markus, holding the upper hand in the custody fight over Isabelle, asks Marianne to meet him alone ostensibly for the child's sake and there blackmails her for sex in exchange for custody.
Marianne and David arrange to meet in Paris precisely so Markus need not be lied to, but Markus works out that they are having an affair and eventually discovers the two of them together.

The aging director 'Bergman' conjures Marianne in his imagination and interviews her about the affair, taking her account of the ruin she caused though he can neither punish nor absolve her, and she parts saying they will meet again.

Gladiator.basis: Maximus, finding his wife and son murdered on Commodus' order, declares in the Colosseum that he will have his vengeance and finally kills Commodus in the arena duel.
Told by Marcus Aurelius that he is unfit to rule and that Maximus will succeed as regent, Commodus secretly assassinates his father and proclaims himself emperor.
Marcus Aurelius' charge to restore the Roman Republic passes to Maximus, who carries it through the arena and, dying, asks for political reforms and Gracchus' reinstatement as senator.
Commodus requests Maximus' loyalty on taking the purple and Maximus refuses, which brings the Praetorians under Quintus to arrest him and condemn his family.
For Maximus' refusal of loyalty, his wife and son are killed at their home near Turgalium, where he finds and buries them.
After Maximus unmasks in the Colosseum and names his vengeance, the crowd's support compels Commodus to let him live.
Ordered by Commodus to finish the defeated Tigris of Gaul, Maximus spares him and the crowd answers with chants of 'Maximus the Merciful'.

Nine Queens.basis: Marcos' plan to cheat Juan of his share via a staged mugging is itself the bait in a con run by Valeria, Sandler, Berta, Vidal and the motorcycle thieves that takes $200,000 from him for a worthless certified check.

The partner Marcos recruits for the day and the sister he leans on to reach Vidal are working together against him — Juan is Valeria's boyfriend, revealed at the warehouse after Marcos is left outside the failed bank.

Marcos poses as a police officer to lift Juan from the convenience store, and the whole scheme runs on Vidal playing a deported Spanish collector, Berta a widow selling her husband's stamps, and Sandler an old associate.
Valeria sets as her price for sleeping with Vidal that Marcos confess to their younger brother Federico that he cheated them both out of the family inheritance, and Marcos does it.

Platform.basis: Cui Mingliang pursues Yin Ruijuan, who answers noncommittally and then rejects him as incompatible; he pines for her through years of touring without contacting her, and only on his final return to Fenyang do they reconnect and marry.
Zhang Jun pressures Zhong Ping into perming her hair and then, having got her pregnant, forces her into an abortion, after which she eventually cuts off contact with him and the troupe.
Zhang and Zhong keep their out-of-wedlock relationship going on the road until the authorities discover it under interrogation and they are sent back to Fenyang.
Cui's peasant cousin Sanming takes a poorly paid job in an unregulated coal mine so his sister Wenying can afford university, and sends her five yuan by Cui with word never to come back.

Dinner with Friends.basis: Tom and Beth's divorce splits the four-way friendship into separate confidences — Karen with Beth, Gabe with Tom — until Gabe and Karen admit at Martha's Vineyard that they no longer feel close to either of them.

Tom tells Gabe over a reheated plate that Beth rejects any form of intimacy and that this is why he sought it with Nancy the travel agent, while Beth's account is that Tom only ever wanted sex, citing the movie-theatre incident.

Tom comes to Gabe and Karen's house to explain his side, and Karen refuses to hear him at all, saying it is clear cut that he is in the wrong, having already declared him no longer her friend on Beth's account alone.

Beth never told Karen that she and David had an affair years earlier in her marriage; Karen only learns it second-hand from Gabe, who heard it from Tom, and is hurt that her closest friend kept it from her.

The Triangle.basis: Once Morgan's boat drifts away and the party is stranded aboard the Queen of Scots, Stu — the friend they all boarded with — kills Julia at the vault, locks Tommy and Charlie in the flooding ballast and mortally wounds Captain Morgan, who names him as repeating the original passenger's cricket-bat massacre.

Adaptation.basis: After Charlie is caught watching Susan Orlean and Laroche take the ghost-orchid drug and have sex, Orlean decides he must be killed to stop him exposing them and drives him into the swamp at gunpoint.

Charlie's twin Donald moves into his house, decides to become a screenwriter too, sells a spec thriller for six or seven figures while Charlie is blocked, and the two only settle what lies between them hiding in the swamp hours before Donald is killed.
Donald walks into Susan Orlean's office presenting himself as Charlie Kaufman and interviews her, and she answers him as the writer adapting her book.

Dolls.basis: Matsumoto breaks off his engagement to Sawako in order to marry the daughter of his company's president, and only afterwards binds himself back to her with the red rope.

Dolls.role: the one who comes to see
Dolls.basis: Matsumoto returns to Sawako only after her suicide attempt has left her semi-catatonic, so his coming back cannot reach the person he abandoned.
Matsumoto takes the semi-catatonic Sawako out of the hospital and walks her through the seasons tied to him by a red rope, keeping her company though she cannot answer him.
Matsumoto sets aside his fiancée to marry his company president's daughter, a match made for his standing in the firm, then abandons it and runs away with Sawako.

Infernal Affairs.basis: Hon Sam puts Lau Kin-ming through the police academy to rise as his mole while Superintendent Wong plants Chan Wing-yan inside Hon's triad, each man relied on for ten years by the organisation he is betraying.
After the botched cocaine transaction Wong and Hon each set their man to find the other's mole, so Lau, assigned by both the HKPF and Hon, hunts the very Chan who is hunting him.

With Chan dead and the internal affairs case closed against Big B, Lau stands at Chan's funeral saluting him as a decorated officer with his own triad past unaccounted for — though an alternate ending has Inspector Cheung arrest him at the lift.
Chan, having deduced that Lau was Hon's mole and sent him the CD of his meeting with Hon, is shot in the head by Inspector Big B on the rooftop as he holds Lau at gunpoint.
Lau, the man Hon raised from a young gangster and placed inside the police, collaborates with Chan to foil Hon's drug deal and then kills him.

Panic Room.basis: Meg and her diabetic daughter Sarah seal themselves behind the steel door of the panic room while Junior, Burnham and Raoul work at the vents and the phone line to get them out.
Burnham, one of the three intruders and the man who built the panic room, hands Sarah her glucagon and finally runs back to shoot Raoul dead as he raises the sledgehammer over Meg.
Raoul tricks Meg out of the panic room to fetch Sarah's syringes and the men take the room with Sarah locked inside, then prepare to leave with her as a hostage until Meg ambushes them on the stairs.
When Junior gives up on the bonds and tries to walk out, his own accomplice Raoul shoots him dead and forces Burnham at gunpoint to finish the robbery.

Unknown Pleasures.basis: Xiao Ji straps a fake bomb to Bin Bin's chest and drives him to the China Construction Bank, then flees on his motorbike to locations unknown while Bin Bin is arrested and told robbery is a capital crime.
Xiao Ji is led off the discotheque dance floor by Qiao San's men, who humiliate and beat him for flirting with Qiao Qiao.
When the enraged Xiao Ji sets out to avenge his beating, Bin Bin stops him by telling him that Qiao San carries a gun on his person.

Intolerable Cruelty.basis: Puffy Krauss von Espy testifies that Marylin asked him to find her a very rich, foolish philandering husband she could easily divorce, and he pointed her to Rex Rexroth.

After marrying Marylin and tearing up his own prenup, Miles discovers that her oil-millionaire ex-husband 'Howard D. Doyle' was only an actor from one of Donaly's soap operas, staged to leave Miles' fortune exposed.
Miles and Herb Myerson hire the hitman Wheezy Joe to kill Marylin, and Marylin offers Joe double to kill Miles instead, until Joe mistakes his gun for his asthma inhaler and shoots himself.

Memories of Murder.basis: Park picks out the scarred, mentally handicapped Baek Kwang-ho on the strength of eye contact and his girlfriend's gossip, and Cho beats a confession out of him until Seo shows the boy could not have committed the crimes.
Park claims he can identify culprits by looking them in the eye, and at the end, with the forensic result inconclusive, he stares into Hyeon-gyu's eyes and decides he is the killer.
Inspector Kwon, described as diligent but unrecognized within the police force, is the one who notices that the same obscure song was requested on local radio on the night of each murder.

The Incredibles.basis: Buddy Pine asks Mr. Incredible to let him be his sidekick during the Bomb Voyage robbery and Bob brushes him off, a refusal Buddy carries for fifteen years until he returns as Syndrome and dies in the plane engine.

Embittered by Bob's rejection, Syndrome builds a fortune on fake superpowers, kills off retired supers by testing the Omnidroid on them, lures Bob to Nomanisan, shoots down the plane carrying his children and finally tries to steal Jack-Jack.
Mirage hires Bob for a well-paid secret mission against the Omnidroid without telling him he is a live test subject in Syndrome's programme to perfect a robot that will kill supers.
Bob hides his firing by Huph and his Nomanisan contract from Helen, letting her believe he still goes to the insurance office, until Edna's beacon and Helen's visit expose it.

After the lawsuits from the man Bob saved and the injured train passengers, the government bans supers from using their powers and relocates the Parrs into an anonymous suburban life until the Omnidroid fight restores public appreciation.

The Terminal.basis: With Krakozhia's coup voiding his passport, Customs seizes Viktor's documents and Frank Dixon confines him to the JFK transit lounge, where he can neither enter the United States nor fly home and lives in a gate under renovation for nine months.

Dixon refuses to sign Viktor's emergency visa and threatens to prosecute his airport friends and deport Gupta to India on an assault charge unless Viktor boards the plane home, and Viktor agrees until Gupta's act frees him.

Viktor's father died with 56 of the 57 autographs from the 'A Great Day in Harlem' photograph collected in the Planters peanut can, and Viktor came to New York solely to get Benny Golson's, which he finally obtains at the hotel.
Gupta runs onto the tarmac in front of Viktor's plane and is taken into custody — accepting deportation to India — so that Viktor does not have to leave the airport under Dixon's threat.
Amelia gets Viktor his one-day emergency visa through her married government boyfriend and tells him in the same breath that she has rekindled that relationship.
Called in to translate for a Russian carrying medicine to his dying father, Viktor invents a way around the paperwork Dixon is using to refuse him, humiliating Dixon in front of his superiors.

Tropical Malady.basis: The soldier is sent alone into the forest to kill the tiger shaman's spirit, follows its pawprints, is knocked down a slope and loses his gun, and ends on his hands and knees telling the tiger in the tree 'I give you my spirit, my flesh, and my memories.'
After sharing a romantic moment stopped at the roadside on the motorcycle, Tong abruptly wanders off into the dark without explanation, and Keng leaves the village with his troops the next day.

Grizzly Man.basis: Treadwell bequeathed his belongings to ex-girlfriend Jewel Palovak, including the camera holding the audio of his and Huguenard's deaths; she could neither listen to it nor destroy it, put it in a bank vault, and only around 2023 destroyed the tape.

Daisy.basis: Park Yi subdues his feelings and keeps his distance from Hye-young because he is a professional hit man and fears his profession would get her hurt.
Hye-young is shot in the neck and left mute trying to shield Jeong Woo from a gangster's bullet, and later steps into the bullet fired at Park Yi and dies.
After Hye-young dies, Park Yi kills his entire gang and faces President Cho in a Mexican standoff in which both men shoot each other.

Inland Empire.basis: Nikki/Sue, feeling stalked by the Phantom, arms herself with a screwdriver, and finally shoots him in the Axxon N. apartment, where he transforms into a grotesque figure with her own face before dying.
In the Inland Empire strand Nikki is stuck in a physically abusive marriage to Smithy in their working-class home, which Polish men periodically visit.

Inland Empire.role: the one held by the earlier tie
Inland Empire.basis: Married to Piotrek — who watches her celebrate from a distance and warns Devon of 'dark consequences' — Nikki begins an affair with her co-star Devon that mirrors the script of On High in Blue Tomorrows.
Sue confronts Billy in front of his family and professes her love, and his wife Doris repeatedly slaps her.
The Lost Girl, held in the Polish hotel room with clients, weeps in front of the television for the length of the film until she escapes into Smithy's house and embraces her husband and son.

Eastern Promises.basis: Nikolai is taken in as Semyon's driver and Kirill's bodyguard, is sponsored for full vor membership and tattooed with stars on knees and chest, while actually working as an undercover FSB agent who then has Semyon arrested for the statutory rape of Tatiana.
Once Anna's uncle Stepan has translated Tatiana's diary naming Semyon as her rapist, Semyon burns the diary and orders Nikolai to kill Stepan, who instead hides him in a hotel in Edinburgh.
Azim lures Nikolai to the public baths where Soyka's brothers, deceived into thinking he is Kirill, stab him repeatedly for a hit Kirill ordered; Nikolai kills both of them.

Anna sees Kirill leave the hospital with a large suitcase and finds Tatiana's baby replaced by roses in the cot; she and Nikolai find Kirill by the Thames, sent by Semyon to drown the infant, and talk him into handing her back.
Semyon rapes the trafficked fourteen-year-old Tatiana to demonstrate to Kirill how to 'break' her, then gives her pills to induce an abortion; she dies giving birth to his child.

Persepolis.basis: After the fundamentalists win the elections Marji lives under compulsory headscarves, black-market music, fined for holding Reza's hand, and a party raid in which the women are detained and Nima falls to his death fleeing across the rooftops.

Marji's parents send her to a lycée in Vienna to escape arrest, and when she returns and decides to leave Iran a second time her mother forbids her ever to come back; her grandmother dies soon after her departure.

In Vienna Marji makes few friends, is thrown out of the nuns' boarding house after insulting one, is accused of stealing by Frau Schloss, and ends up living on the street until bronchitis nearly kills her.
Marji's grandmother tells her that her grandfather and her uncle Anoosh both died for freedom and that she must never sacrifice her integrity; before leaving Iran Marji visits their graves.
Marji is expelled after rebutting her teacher's lies about government abuses, and her speech to the university forum challenging its sexist double standard changes nothing.
Stopped by the fundamentalist police for wearing makeup, Marji points to a man who had been ogling her and claims he made indecent comments, and her grandmother rebukes her for it.

The Man from London.basis: From his signal tower Maloin sees one man knocked into the water at the quayside and the other flee, then climbs down, takes the briefcase of English banknotes and tells no one — not Morrison when questioned during his shift, not his family — until he finally brings the case to the tavern and confesses.

Maloin hides the £55,000 from Camélia and Henriette, turns brusque at dinner, drags Henriette out of the butcher's job and buys her an expensive mink stole, while Camélia can only ask uncomprehendingly why he has ruined the girl's prospects and spent their savings.

Told by Henriette that a man is locked in their seaside hut, Maloin goes there, calls Brown's name, steps inside and comes out breathing heavily — having killed the one man hunting the briefcase he had taken.

Morrison, after taking Maloin's confession and visiting the hut with Brown's widow, hands Maloin an envelope of the recovered money, tells him the case was self-defence and advises him to go home and forget the whole affair.

There Will Be Blood.basis: Daniel adopts the orphaned baby H.W. after a derrick accident kills the boy's father, specifically so he can present himself as a family man to investors, and only decades later tells H.W. he was a bastard from a basket used as a 'sweet face' to buy land.
Daniel raises H.W. as his son and withholds his real parentage until the 1927 quarrel over dissolving the partnership, when he mocks H.W.'s deafness and reveals his origins as a way of disowning him.

After the blowout deafens H.W. and the boy sets fire to their shack, Daniel chases him down, restrains him and puts him on a train to a school for the deaf in San Francisco; Eli later forces him to confess at the baptism that he abandoned his child.

A stranger arrives claiming to be Daniel's half-brother Henry, is taken in and worked alongside until he fails to recognise a childhood joke and admits at gunpoint that he was only a friend of the real Henry, who died of tuberculosis — whereupon Daniel shoots and buries him.

Bandy, whose ranch is the last holdout blocking the Union Oil pipeline and who knows of the murder, sets his price: Daniel must be publicly baptised and repent in Eli's church before he gets the easement.

When Eli publicly demands the $5,000 still owed for the church, Daniel beats him and rubs him in the oil-soaked mud in front of the crew — and Eli goes home to be berated at the family dinner table for having trusted Daniel.

Doubt.basis: Sister Aloysius fixes Flynn's guilt from a boy pulling away in the courtyard, alcohol on Donald Miller's breath and an undershirt in a locker, and when Flynn demands what proof she has she answers that all she has is her certainty.

Aloysius invents a nun at Flynn's former parish who told her of past infringements and threatens blackmail unless he resigns immediately; he requests the transfer, delivers a final homily, and is then given a better post at a larger church.

When Aloysius takes her suspicions about Donald to Flynn and to the boy's mother, Flynn charges her with insubordination and acting outside her duties and threatens to have her removed from her position as principal if she does not back down.

Mrs. Miller hears out Aloysius's account of what may be happening to Donald and asks her to leave it alone until June — the boy is beaten by his father for being gay, Flynn is the only man who has shown him kindness, and removal would cost him the school.

The Dust of Time.basis: Eleni and Spyros are arrested and separated the night of Stalin's death in 1953, and hold to each other across Siberia, the Hungarian border and twenty years until Spyros proposes to her in the Ontario bar where she works in 1974.
In Siberia in 1956 Eleni puts her three-year-old son on a train to Moscow to be raised by Jacob's older sister, and only meets him again as the grown filmmaker A in Canada in 1974.

Jacob is with Eleni from the Temirtau newsreel in 1953, is ditched when she jumps on the tram with Spyros, crosses the Hungarian border with her in 1973 only for her to end it and send him on to Israel, and after visiting her and Spyros in Berlin in 1999 he drowns himself in the Spree.

The Spiderwick Chronicles.basis: Jared tells his mother and siblings he has found Arthur's Field Guide and that fairies are real; Helen disbelieves him through the car argument until the goblins break the mushroom circle and the family has to fight them off in the kitchen.
Richard has left the family for another woman in New York, Jared keeps failing to reach him by phone until Mallory tells him the truth, and Jared ends by refusing to live with his father at all.

The sylphs have kept Arthur Spiderwick in their realm for eighty years and refuse to let Jared, Simon and Mallory leave because they know too much about the fairies, until Arthur distracts them with the fake book.

Mulgarath appears in the house as the children's father Richard, and as an old man at the goblin campsite before that, until Jared's suspicion at his words makes him stab the false Richard and Hogsqueal eats the raven he turns into.

WALL-E.basis: WALL-E is smitten with EVE, tends her body through her standby shutdown and refuses the escape pod she tries to send him home in, and only when she watches the recordings of him caring for her does she understand his feelings and return them.

AUTO, the autopilot serving Captain McCrea, mutinies when McCrea tries to override directive A113 — electrocuting WALL-E, dumping him and EVE down the garbage chute and confining McCrea to his quarters — until McCrea rises from his chair and switches him to manual.
AUTO reveals the secret no-return directive A113 recorded by Buy n Large's CEO Shelby Forthright in 2110, which he had been acting on when he ordered GO-4 to destroy the plant.
EVE blames WALL-E for the missing seedling and he is designated a rogue robot, until the two of them see GO-4 stowing the plant in a self-destructing escape pod.

Waltz with Bashir.basis: The Phalange militia slaughters the inhabitants of Sabra and Shatila in retaliation for the assassination of Bachir Gemayel, while Ari's unit fires flares over the camps through the night.
Ari's unit stands in 'the second or third ring' lighting the sky for the Israeli-allied Phalange who do the killing, and Ari concludes he felt as responsible as the men who carried it out.
Boaz's fellow soldiers, knowing he could not shoot a person, hand him the job of shooting the village dogs, and he can still name each of the 26 he killed.

A Serious Man.basis: Judith tells Larry she has fallen in love with the widower Sy Ableman and needs a get, then empties their bank accounts and leaves him penniless.

Larry goes to his synagogue for consolation and gets Rabbi Scott's advice to change his 'perspective', Rabbi Nachtner's anecdote about Hebrew letters on a goy's teeth, and Marshak, who will not see him at all.
Sy Ableman and Judith insist Larry move out to the Jolly Roger motel, and after Sy dies in a car crash Larry is made to pay for the funeral at which Sy is eulogized as 'a serious man'.

Clive Park's father threatens to sue Larry for defamation if he calls the envelope of cash a bribe and for theft if he keeps it without passing Clive, and Larry finally changes the grade from F to C−.

Larry keeps his brother Arthur, who sleeps on the couch draining his sebaceous cyst and filling the 'Mentaculus', consoles him over the gambling and sodomy charges, and is left with the $3,000 bill from Arthur's lawyer.

The White Ribbon.basis: The doctor, kind to the village children, humiliates the midwife he sleeps with and sexually abuses his own teenage daughter; the pastor ties his son's hands to the bed frame each night after the boy confesses to 'impure' touching.
The pastor makes his children wear white ribbons as a standing reminder of the purity they have strayed from, and runs confirmation classes that leave them guilty over small transgressions.
Shortly after the pastor berates his daughter in front of the confirmation class, she takes scissors to his parakeet's cage and he finds the bird on his desk impaled in the shape of a cross.
The wire across the trees, the burnt barn, the caned Sigi and the near-blinding of the midwife's handicapped son go unexplained, and rumours settle on the doctor and the midwife as the ones at fault.
When the schoolteacher comes to the rectory to say the pastor's children and pupils had prior knowledge of the attacks, the pastor takes offence and threatens to have him jailed if he repeats it.
The midwife commandeers the schoolteacher's bicycle to ride to the police, saying her son has told her who attacked him, and neither she nor the boy is ever seen again.
After his son Sigi is found bound and caned in the sawmill, the baron summarily dismisses Eva, the nanny, without cause.

Postcard.basis: Sadazo, expecting to die in the Philippines, asks Matsuyama to carry his wife Tomoko's postcard back to her and say he received it before dying; after the war Matsuyama makes his way to Tomoko's house to discharge that errand.

Matsuyama comes home from the navy alive while Sadazo and Sanpei did not, is told by his own wife that she wishes he had died in the war, and stands before Tomoko as the man who survived to deliver her husband's postcard.
Matsuyama returns to find his wife ran away after an affair with his own father and is working as a bar hostess in Osaka; they meet, argue, and part.
After Yukichi dies of a heart condition during farm work, Chiyo gives Tomoko some money and then hangs herself, leaving Tomoko alone in the house with the ashes of both sons.

The Ghost Writer.basis: McAra drowns after discovering Lang's torture-flight involvement and Ruth's recruitment, and the Ghost, having decoded the same message from the first words of McAra's chapters and passed a note to Ruth, is hit by an accelerating car outside the book launch.

Ruth, whom Lang claims he met at Cambridge, was in fact tutored and recruited as a CIA agent by Professor Paul Emmett at Harvard, and steered a Prime Minister whose every decision benefited US interests until he was assassinated.

The nameless writer is hired by Rhinehart to finish Lang's autobiography after the previous ghost McAra drowns, works from McAra's manuscript, drives McAra's car to Emmett's Belmont house, and ends up dead in the street as McAra did on the beach.

The Ghost Writer.role: the ones acting in the dark
The Ghost Writer.basis: The Ghost's hiring, the envelope under the drawer, the flight back to Old Haven aboard Lang's jet and Rycart's encouragement all move him through an arrangement set by Emmett, the military contractor and Ruth, which he only glimpses at the launch party.
The writer is never named in the film and writes Lang's autobiography — then completes it for posthumous publication — with the book issued under Lang's name at a London launch.

From Up on Poppy Hill.basis: After Umi shows Shun the photograph of the three naval men, Shun's father's account of the birth certificate leads Shun to tell Umi they are siblings, and the two repress their feelings on that basis until Onodera confirms at the harbour that Yūichirō only registered Shun as his own and they share no blood.

Shun grows up as a Kazama without being told that Yūichirō Sawamura brought him to the house as an infant with a Family Registry certificate, and Ryoko withholds until her return from the United States that his real father was Hiroshi Tachibana, killed on a repatriation ship in 1945.

The Kazamas, who had just lost their own newborn, take in the infant Shun when Yūichirō arrives one evening with him, after Ryoko—already pregnant with Umi—cannot raise him and his other relatives are killed in the bombing of Nagasaki.

Every morning Umi raises the signal flags reading "I pray for safe voyages" over Yokohama harbour for her father Yūichirō, killed on a supply ship in the Korean War; by the end she goes on raising them but no longer only for him.

Into the Abyss.basis: Michael Perry and Jason Burkett kill Sandra Stotler for her car, and then, locked out of her gated community, wait for her grandson Adam and kill him and his friend Jeremy Richardson to get Adam's gate-opener.

Michael Perry is interviewed on death row eight days before his execution on July 1, 2010, while Jason Burkett receives life instead, and Herzog also interviews a chaplain and a former death house worker who retired after taking part in Karla Faye Tucker's execution.
Although details in Michael's original confession led police to the bodies of Adam and Jeremy, both Michael and Jason deny to Herzog in prison that they had any involvement in the killings.
Jason Burkett's father was incarcerated for most of Jason's life and his emotional appeal on that account helps spare Jason the death sentence; the two are now imprisoned in the same facility.

The Tree of Life.basis: Mr. O'Brien screams at his wife, harshly disciplines Jack and teaches the boys to fight and trust no one, and the household only breathes freely when he leaves on a business trip; Jack is still marked by it as a world-weary architect in 2010.

As a teenager Jack learns his parents are frustrated with their lives — his father's patent suit lost and his music abandoned, his mother living under her husband's thumb — and he stops holding to their 'nature and grace' account of the world, resenting his father and criticising his mother.

Before the family leaves the Waco house for the last time, Mr. O'Brien asks Jack to forgive him for his harshness and tries to conciliate him by saying he takes after his mother; Jack answers that he better resembles his father.
Mr. O'Brien disciplines Jack harshly while cutting R.L. slack because of their shared love of music, and Jack resents being the son passed over.
Mrs. O'Brien, the parent Jack sees as grace, never stands up to her domineering husband on the boys' behalf, and Jack criticises her for it.

Lincoln.basis: Lincoln pushes the Thirteenth Amendment through the House before the slave states return because the Emancipation Proclamation may be voided by the courts and freed slaves re-enslaved; the vote carries by two, with Black visitors watching from the gallery.

Francis Preston Blair controls the conservative faction's votes Lincoln cannot pass the amendment without, and releases them only on condition that Lincoln authorise his peace mission to the Confederates.

The Act of Killing.basis: Anwar Congo, Herman Koto and the Pancasila Youth boast on Indonesian television about killing alleged communists and are backed by high-ranking officials including then-vice president Jusuf Kalla, so no one can be made to answer for the 1965-66 massacres.

The Act of Killing.role: the one who comes to see
The Act of Killing.basis: Decades after strangling as many as 1,000 people, Congo panics while playing a victim in the re-enactment, senses what those he killed felt, and returns to his old killing site to retch.

The Act of Killing.role: the one who fixes the account
The Act of Killing.basis: The propaganda film Pengkhianatan G30S/PKI establishes that the communists perpetrated the 30 September Movement and glorifies the killings, an account Congo praises as validating him while the dead and their families have no purchase on it.
The ethnic Chinese who survived the massacres go on having their money extorted by the same gangsters, who also rig elections, clear land for developers and run gambling and drug rackets.
Pressed by Oppenheimer, Adi Zulkadry denies the genocide was a war crime by pointing to the Iraq War and the Native American genocide, and dismisses Congo's nightmares as nerve issues.

Like Father, Like Son.basis: After the hospital reveals Keita and Ryūsei were switched at birth, the Nonomiyas and the Saikis meet, share photos and negotiate between themselves whether to keep the boys they raised or take back their biological sons.

Ryōta neglects Midori and Keita for his architecture work, and only when he finds a cache of photos Keita secretly took of him sleeping does he break down and later apologise to the boy for his failures as a father.
Ryōta and Midori permanently exchange Keita, the son they raised for six years, into the Saiki household after first offending the Saikis by proposing to buy both boys.
The nurse admits in court that, newly married and struggling with her stepchildren, she grew envious of the Nonomiyas' happiness and spitefully swapped the two newborns.
Ryōta goes to the nurse's apartment to hand back her apology money and berate her for ruining his family, and her stepson steps in to defend her.

Prisoners.basis: Anna Dover and Joy Birch are taken from outside the family Thanksgiving by Holly Jones, who drugs them, and their fathers and Detective Loki spend the film trying to get them back.
Keller Dover kidnaps Alex Jones, chains him in an empty building he owns and tortures him for days to make him give up where the girls are, getting only cryptic talk about a maze.

Keller fixes on Alex after the whispered line "They didn't cry 'til I left them," though Loki has established Alex's diminished IQ and clean RV, and Alex turns out to have been Holly's first abducted child.

Holly explains she and her husband lost their son to cancer and their faith with him, and began abducting other people's children to wage a war on God and make demons of the parents; Loki shoots her dead.
Franklin Birch is talked out of freeing Alex by his wife Nancy, and the couple decide neither to stop Keller's torture nor to tell the police.
Holly shoots and wounds Keller at her house and drops him into the hidden pit in her yard, where he finds Anna's whistle and Loki only faintly hears it blowing at the end.

The Attorney.basis: At the sedition trial Song points out constitutional violations and the prosecutors and judge tell him normal laws do not apply in national-security cases, so the students lose despite the tortured confessions and get up to two years.

Detective Cha, ordered to purge Busan of communists even by fabrication, has schoolboy Park and other students charged with sedition for reading EH Carr's What Is History?, which Song shows was written by a British ambassador.

Lt Yoon, the medical officer who oversaw the tortured detainees, agrees to describe the torture methods in court, and Cha's superiors frame him for desertion to nullify his testimony and send him to prison.
Cha's agents torture Park and the other students until they sign confessions, and Cha then testifies that the bruises were self-inflicted.
Busan's lawyers look down on Song for passing the bar without university, and by 1987, when he is arrested for sedition himself, 99 of the city's 142 lawyers attend his hearing in support.

The Past.basis: Ahmad flies back to France after four years to sign the divorce papers and finds Marie living with Samir, pregnant by him, and himself sharing a room with Samir's son Fouad.

Lucie believes she drove Samir's wife to drink bleach by forwarding the affair emails, until Naïma reveals the wife was not in the shop that day, that Naïma herself took Lucie's call and supplied the address, and that the wife probably never read the emails.
Pressed by Ahmad, Lucie tells Marie that she forwarded her and Samir's email correspondence to Samir's wife the day before the suicide attempt, and Marie orders her out of the house.
Samir carried on the affair with Marie while married, insisting to Ahmad that his wife knew nothing of it and that her depression and a customer incident caused the suicide attempt.
Samir agrees with Marie that they should focus on their future and then goes to the hospital with perfumes for his comatose wife, asking her to squeeze his hand.

In the closing scene Samir sprays his cologne on his neck, leans over his comatose wife's hospital bed and whispers to her to squeeze his hand if she can smell it; a tear runs down her cheek but she does not respond.

Tokyo Family.basis: Koichi cancels the Yokohama sightseeing for a medical emergency, Shigeko parks her parents in a client's luxury hotel and then says they cannot stay with her because of a neighbourhood meeting, so Shukichi and Tomiko spend the night apart.
Noriko, Shoji's fiancée, fears she is not accepted by the Hirayamas at Tomiko's funeral, and Shukichi thanks her, gives her Tomiko's watch as a keepsake and asks her to look after his son.

Shukichi drinks heavily with his old friend Sanpei against Koichi's warnings and vomits in Shigeko's salon, and Tomiko collapses on the stairs on her way to grandson Isamu's room and dies the next morning.

Mad Max: Fury Road.basis: Immortan Joe keeps his five 'wives' — Toast, Capable, Cheedo, the Dag and the pregnant Angharad — inside the Citadel as breeders, and leads his entire army to drag them back when they flee in the War Rig; the confinement ends only when Furiosa kills him.
Furiosa, Joe's own Imperator, is sent out with the War Rig to trade for petrol and instead smuggles his wives out in it, and finally boards his truck and kills him while Toast distracts him.

Max is captured by the War Boys and, as a universal donor, strapped to Nux's car to be bled into him as a living blood bag; by the end he opens his own vein deliberately to transfuse Furiosa and save her.
Joe throws his War Boys — including the dying Nux, sent to blow up the Rig and later to carjack it — into the pursuit to recover the wives that hold up his rule at the Citadel.

Certain Women.basis: Laura has told Fuller for eight months that accepting the company's small settlement killed his claim, and he only accepts it when she takes him to a second, male lawyer who says exactly the same thing.

The employee file Fuller makes Laura read aloud during the hostage standoff spells out how the company cheated him out of his rightful disability settlement, but the settlement he signed bars any suit and it is Fuller, not the company, who ends up in prison.

Fuller asks Laura to walk out the front and stall the police as though he had a gun on her so he can slip out the back, and she instead tells them exactly where he is — though she later visits him in prison and agrees to answer his letters.

Gina is the one pressing for the sandstone, but Albert will only address Ryan, who gives her no backing in the negotiation and undermines her with their daughter; at the closing barbecue Ryan finally acknowledges the work she has done on the house.

Gina secretly tapes her conversation with the unfocused elderly Albert to pin down his tentative agreement over the sandstone, and when she and Ryan come back to load the truck he watches from the window and will not return her wave.

Jamie keeps returning to a night class on education law she has no interest in, brings a horse for Beth to ride to the diner, and after Beth quits without a word drives four hours to Livingston to say she came because otherwise she would never see her again — and Beth says nothing back.
Beth drives an eight-hour round trip twice a week from Livingston to teach the Belfry night class on top of her real job, and eventually quits and is replaced by a permanent teacher.

A Taxi Driver.basis: Man-seob takes the Gwangju fare only for the 100,000 won, then — after hearing the radio blame North Korean infiltrators — turns his taxi around at Suncheon and goes back to a city and a journalist he owes nothing to.

At the airport Man-seob writes 'Kim Sa-bok' and a cigarette company's phone number in Peter's notebook, so Peter thanks a name that does not exist at his 2003 award and dies in 2016 without finding him.

DSC officers chase Peter for his footage of the crackdown and seize Jae-sik, who shouts for Peter to share the film with the world; soldiers at the mountain roadblock are ordered to stop any foreigners and fire on the taxi.
Man-seob leaves Gwangju at dawn for his young daughter in Seoul, whom he cannot reach by phone, then abandons that drive to return to Peter, and only reaches her once Peter is on the plane.
The Gwangju taxi drivers throw their cars into the DSC pursuit and die so that Man-seob's taxi and Peter's film can get clear.
Soldiers fire on Gwangju civilians in the street, including those dragging the wounded away, while the state broadcasts that North Korean infiltrators caused the chaos.

All the Money in the World.basis: The 'Ndrangheta demand $17 million for 16-year-old Paul, the figure is negotiated down to $4 million, and Gail and Chace leave the cash at a remote drop before being phoned to collect him from a construction site.

Gail travels to Getty's English estate to beg for the ransom for his own grandson and he refuses, saying paying would only invite more kidnappings of his family, sending Chace to investigate instead of money.

Getty finally agrees to pay only if Gail signs full custody of all her children over to their near-vegetative father — in effect to Getty — and then hands over just $1 million, the tax-deductible maximum.
With the ransom unpaid month after month, Paul's second set of captors cut off his ear and mail it to a newspaper, while Getty, who is withholding the money, sits untouched in England.
Cinquanta, one of Paul's own captors, tells him to run rather than wait at the handover and later attacks the criminal who corners him in Lauria so Paul can reach Gail.

Okja.basis: Dr. Johnny Wilcox declares Okja the best super pig and Mirando trucks her off the mountain to New York, and Mija chases the truck through Seoul and follows her across the world to get her back.
Mija tells the ALF through K that she only wants Okja returned to the mountains, and K deliberately translates it as agreement to the plan to let Okja be recaptured with a recorder in her ear.
