On the slaughterhouse ramp Mija holds out her grandfather's solid gold pig to Nancy, who takes it as a sound business deal and lets Okja walk out.
Lucy Mirando flies Mija to New York and stages a heart-warming reunion with her pig purely to limit PR damage, while Okja is being force-bred and cut for a taste test in the lab.
Only as Okja is being taken does the grandfather hand Mija the gold pig figurine and admit he had been saving up to replace Okja for the day she was collected.

Song to Song.basis: Faye hides her ongoing affair with the producer Cook from BV even while the three travel together in Mexico, and only admits it when BV, seeing her crying and acting strangely, asks point blank whether she slept with him.
BV finds that Cook has put all the copyrights in his own name and is splitting profits on work BV does himself, which ends their professional and personal relationship.
Cook courts and marries Rhonda, a former teacher waiting tables while she and her mother Miranda grow desperate for money, and pays to have a house built for Miranda; Rhonda later takes her own life.

Honeyland.basis: Hatidže tells Hussein Sam to always leave half the honey for the bees; he sells the entire stock to satisfy a customer, his colonies then raid hers in winter and her colony collapses exactly as she warned.
Hatidže instructs Sam in wild beekeeping and hands him bees to start his own colony, and what comes back is the destruction of her own hives and her livelihood.

Hatidže keeps her 85-year-old, partly blind and bedridden mother Nazife, who is wholly dependent on her, in a village with no electricity or running water until Nazife dies and Hatidže is left alone in Bekirlija.

Midsommar.basis: Dani, still grieving her sister's murder-suicide of their parents, stays attached to Christian, who had intended to break up with her and only reluctantly invites her to Sweden after an argument, then takes part in the sex ritual with Maja.
Pelle and Ingemar lure Mark, Josh, Simon and Connie to the Hårga as four of the nine bodies the commune needs to purge itself of evil, a purpose the visitors are told only at the final ceremony.
Crowned May Queen, Dani is made to choose between a commune member and the paralyzed Christian, picks Christian, and watches him burn sewn into a bear's carcass before she slowly smiles.

Pelle tells Dani he too was orphaned when his parents burned to death and that the commune became his family, then asks whether she feels supported by Christian, and she ends the film absorbed into the Hårga as May Queen.
Two Hårga elders throw themselves off a cliff in the ättestupa and the survivor's head is crushed with a mallet, Siv explaining that every member does this at 72.

Portrait of a Lady on Fire.basis: Héloïse, brought back from the convent after her sister's suicide, is betrothed by the Countess to a Milanese nobleman she has never met, and the portrait Marianne is hired to paint is the instrument of that transaction; the film ends with Héloïse married in Milan.

Marianne is installed in the house as Héloïse's hired walking companion so she can memorise her face on the coastal walks and paint her in secret, until she confesses the commission and destroys the first portrait.

After the Countess's return parts them, Marianne sees Héloïse only twice more — in a gallery portrait where Héloïse holds her book open at the edge of page 28, and across a Milan concert hall as Héloïse weeps at the Vivaldi Presto Marianne once played her on the harpsichord.

Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story.basis: Boxer Rubin 'Hurricane' Carter is wrongfully convicted of murder, and the tour's campaign — Dylan's unscheduled visit to record executives to rush out 'Hurricane', Congressman Tanner persuading President Carter to intervene — leads to the retrial and his release.

The Tragedy of Macbeth.basis: Macbeth, newly invested as Thane of Cawdor by King Duncan and passed over when Duncan names Malcolm prince of Cumberland, murders the sleeping King in his own castle and takes the throne.
Lady Macbeth, knowing the witches' prophecies, talks her hesitating husband into the regicide and drugs Duncan's servants, but it is Macbeth who holds the knife.
Uneasy at the prophecy that Banquo shall father a line of kings, Macbeth sends assassins — with Ross as the third murderer — to kill Banquo and his son Fleance.
Warned to beware Macduff, Macbeth orders the entire Macduff household slaughtered though Macduff himself has already fled to England, and Ross must carry news of the family's demise to him.
Grief-stricken at his family's slaughter, Macduff vows revenge, marches on Dunsinane with Malcolm's English-backed army, declares himself untimely ripped from his mother's body, and beheads Macbeth.
After Macduff discovers Duncan's body, Macbeth summarily executes the drugged servants, presenting it as just punishment for a betrayal they did not commit.

Aftersun.basis: Calum keeps his depression and turmoil from 11-year-old Sophie behind a facade of contentment — hiding his smoking, practising tai chi and reading self-help books alone, sobbing in the hotel room after the birthday song while she sleeps unaware.

When Sophie loses the expensive scuba mask Calum feigns nonchalance, but she reads what he actually feels and comforts him; later she covers his naked sleeping body with a sheet without either of them naming what is wrong.
Adult Sophie in New York replays the MiniDV footage from Turkey and, in the rave sequences, pushes through the strobing crowd toward Calum, briefly holding him before he falls from her grasp.
Calum waves Sophie onto her flight home, leaving behind only the postcard telling her never to forget he loves her and the rug that later lies worn on her bedroom floor, with nothing said about why.

Avatar: The Way of Water.basis: Recombinant Quaritch hunts Jake Sully across Pandora, forcing him to abandon the Omatikaya for the Metkayina reefs, until Quaritch tracks Norm and Max's aircraft to the archipelago and Jake resolves he can no longer keep running.

Quaritch seizes Kiri, Tuk, Lo'ak and Spider aboard the whaling ship and demands Jake surrender himself in exchange for his children, later holding a blade to Kiri until Neytiri threatens Spider in return.

The Sully family are granted asylum by the Metkayina but must learn their ways as outsiders, with Tonowari's son Aonung luring Lo'ak onto a hunting trip and stranding him in dangerous water; Tonowari finally declares them part of the clan.
Lo'ak befriends and mind-links with Payakan, the Tulkun exiled by his own kind for breaking the vow of pacifism, and Payakan repays it by attacking Quaritch's ship and pulling Jake from the wreck.

Spider, raised among the Sullys but recognized as Quaritch's son, teaches his father Na'vi language and culture, then sabotages the RDA vessel, saves Quaritch from drowning, and refuses to stay with him.
Neteyam goes back to pull Lo'ak, Tsireya and Spider out of the sinking RDA ship and is fatally shot during their escape.

No Bears.basis: The Jaban villagers repeatedly demand that Panahi hand over the photo of Gozal and Solduz, take his camera's memory card, and finally summon him to the swearing room to swear on the Quran that he never took or saw it; he offers a filmed oath instead and the impasse holds.

Gozal and Solduz love each other against the village's rule that her umbilical cord was cut in Jacob's name, keep it hidden, plan to elope in a week, and are both shot dead trying to cross the border.

Bakhtiar lets Zara believe he has obtained a real passport when it is a film prop, she interrupts the shoot to say so to Panahi's camera and walks off, and her body is later found drowned on the shore.
Ghanbar tells Panahi the photo turmoil has become unbearable and that the police and Revolutionary Guards are involved, and asks him to leave Jaban.

Tár.role: the one who cannot contest it
Tár.basis: A manipulatively edited video of Lydia's Juilliard masterclass goes viral, a New York Post piece accuses her of sexual predation and an unseen hand rewrites her Wikipedia page, and nothing she does — deposition, book tour, storming the stage — touches the account.

Lydia keeps Francesca as assistant and confidante, dangles Sebastian's assistant-conductor post, then drops the promotion after Sebastian's accusation of favoritism; Francesca resigns and hands Lydia's emails with Krista to the plaintiffs.
Krista Taylor, once mentored by Lydia, is blacklisted after their dispute, sends disturbing emails that Lydia has Francesca delete, and ends her own life.

Lydia hides her pursuit of Olga from Sharon — telling her the fall she took while following Olga home was a mugging — and Sharon, furious at the allegations and the lack of transparency, bars her from seeing Petra.

Killers of the Flower Moon.basis: Ernest marries Mollie, raises three children with her, then on Hale's order poisons her insulin to 'slow her down' while she sickens and her family is killed off around her.
Hale has Minnie, Anna, Henry Roan, and Reta and Bill killed — the last by a house bombing — so that Mollie's headrights concentrate and pass through Ernest to him.

Hale, posing as the Osage's friendly benefactor, has Ernest arrange Henry Roan's shooting and Reta's house bombing and Byron kill Anna, keeping his own hands clean until Ernest turns state's evidence.
The sheriff and judges are in Hale's pocket so none of the murders are investigated, and when Mollie hires detective William J. Burns he is severely beaten by Ernest and Byron.
After surviving the poisoning and Ernest's courtroom testimony, Mollie leaves him when he will not admit that he was the one poisoning her insulin.
The law deems full and half-blood Osage 'incompetent' and installs court-appointed white legal guardians over their oil money, so Mollie's family cannot control what they own.

To Catch a Killer.basis: Eleanor Falco and Lammark track the New Year's Eve sniper from the burned sniper's nest through the mall footage, the slaughterhouse and Lang's hiring records to Dean Possey's parents' farm, and Eleanor ends up alone in the house with the man she has spent the film reading, talking him toward sleep before the deputies arrive.

Dean Possey, an ex-slaughterhouse worker who once killed the coworker who bullied him, shoots 29 strangers at New Year's parties from a downtown high-rise and later empties an Uzi into shoppers who had done nothing to him beyond a changing-room accusation.

At Baltimore FBI headquarters Eleanor is offered a senior post in exchange for never speaking about the Bureau's forced cornerstore raid and the firing that led to Lammark's death, and she takes the deal after bargaining up to special agent, a public commendation for Lammark and full pension for his husband.

Lammark's superiors order the arrest of the cable-news caller over his objections, and when the shootout kills the caller's friends and maims Marquand the Bureau blames Lammark for the investigation's failures and fires him.

After killing Lammark and watching his mother shoot herself outside the shed, Dean sits with Eleanor and asks her to let him fall asleep and then execute him, and she agrees; when the sheriff arrives he takes it as betrayal and finally raises his weapon at the massed officers to be shot.

Megalopolis.basis: District Attorney Cicero prosecuted Cesar for his wife's murder and later admits, as blackmail material offered at the Megalopolis site, that he knew all along she had taken her own life and prosecuted maliciously anyway.

Mayor Cicero, unimpressed by the construction site his pregnant daughter Julia brings him to, begs Cesar to leave her and offers his own confession of malicious prosecution as the price; Cesar declines, and Cicero ends the film holding their daughter Sunny Hope.

Clodio Pulcher, kept close as a nephew while Hamilton Crassus III's mind and health decline, works with Wow Platinum to manipulate the old man into handing over control of the Crassus bank; when Crassus learns of the duplicity he strokes out, then kills Wow with a hidden bow and arrow.
Wow Platinum freezes Cesar's account at the Crassus bank to force him to abandon Julia and marry her, and Megalopolis only resumes once Crassus restores the financing after her death.

To neutralize Cesar politically, Pulcher leaks paparazzi video of him having sex with the publicly chaste teen star Vesta Sweetwater, and Cicero arrests him for statutory rape until Julia proves Vesta faked her age and is in her twenties.

Bugonia.basis: Teddy Gatz, whose mother Sandy was left comatose by an Auxolith clinical trial, abducts the company's CEO Michelle Fuller with his cousin Don, shaves her head, coats her in antihistamine cream and shocks her with electricity in his basement.

Michelle spends the film insisting she is only a pharmaceutical CEO and offering Teddy a revised Atlantis-and-ark history to placate him, then walks into her office closet, teleports to the mothership and is revealed as the Andromedan emperor, who domes the Earth and kills every human.

Teddy's four-day plan to force a meeting with the Andromedan emperor before the lunar eclipse ends with him walking into Michelle's fake teleporter in a suicide vest and being detonated by the enter key on her desk calculator.

Michelle tells the frantic Teddy that the bottle of antifreeze in her car is an Andromedan antidote for his mother, and he drives to the hospital and injects it into Sandy's IV bag, killing her, while Michelle frees herself in the basement.

Deputy sheriff Casey, Teddy's childhood babysitter, comes to the house searching for Michelle, is knocked out and chained in the basement, and when he hears Don's gunshot Teddy beats him to death with a shovel.

Honey Don't!.basis: MG, the policewoman Honey picks up at the station and takes to bed in her own apartment, turns out to be Mia's killer and is holding Corinne captive in her basement, where she stabs Honey before Honey scalds her with the kettle and shoots her.

Corinne vanishes after her shift at Wiener Heaven and Heidi phones Honey for help; Honey hunts the town for her until she spots Corinne's green lipstick on a teacup at MG's house and finds her alive in the basement.
The old man Corinne fled from at the bus stop turns out to be Honey and Heidi's estranged father, who approaches Honey wanting to reconnect and offers what he saw of Corinne as his opening.
Detective Marty Metakawich asks Honey for a date at the crash scene and thinks she is joking when she says she likes girls, and asks her out again at the end, drawing the same answer.
When Corinne turns up assaulted by her boyfriend Mickie, Honey trades silence for a condition — she will not tell Heidi if Corinne stops seeing him — and MG agrees not to report the assault either.
